experiment: E256 (procedural_rl), cell P2.56 run 1: three procedural next-token tasks on the 67M (day/month sequences, closing brackets and quotes, single-digit addition after two worked sums), each by RL (E220's recipe, one sampled token as E224) and by SFT on demonstrations, 3 seeds, every state stopped at E220's update size, plus Gaussian updates at RL's per-matrix norms; E222's readings of every state

settings.lr_source: E220's (E53's lowercase recipe: Adam 3e-5, betas 0.9/0.999, no weight decay), for RL and SFT alike
settings.grad_clip_source: E53's recipe, as E220 and E224
settings.k_source: E220's: 16 prompts x group of 8 = 128 samples per RL step; one sampled token each, as E224
settings.sft_batch_source: E53's batch of 32, as E220's demo arm
settings.size_target_source: E220's (predictions_E220.json settings.size_target), also E224's: every arm stops at the first step with ||dW|| / ||W0|| at or above it
settings.max_steps_source: E220's cap; E224's RL arms reached the target in 22-31 steps
settings.kl_rows_source: E215's KL read (Pile val rows 0-63), as E220 and E224; a reading, not the stop
settings.prompt_len_source: E224's: a Pile row's first tokens as fill, then the template, 64 tokens; the cue is the last
settings.seq_source: E224's sequence task unchanged (rl_tasks_2191.sequence_cores): 2 to 5 names shown, 4 lists x starts x 4 lengths x 6 separators = 912 templates
settings.bracket_source: 2 to 4 openers from ( [ { " with at most one quote and 1 to depth-1 closers shown: 690 structures (counted by rl_tasks.bracket_structures, dry run). Depth 4 is where a 67M's top-1 on Dyck-like closing is expected to fall off; not sourced beyond that, so the benchmark reads it
settings.shots_source: chosen here, a departure from E224 (0 shots): E224's W0 held-out top-1 on bare addition was 0.045 (stage2c_ctl.json .w0.addition.top1), under the filed band's 0.05, so two worked sums of other facts are shown to put the base model inside the band (the whip-lead's 'benchmark first that the 67M can partly do each task'). The benchmark measures it
settings.held_frac_source: E224's: a fifth of the sequence templates and of the bracket structures held out
settings.n_train_source: E224's training items per task (RL prompts and SFT demonstrations)
settings.n_held_source: the brief (whip-lead 2026-11-21): 256 held-out prompts per task for the benchmark; the same items are every training read and the read rows (E222 read 200, E224 256)
settings.n_fit_source: E224's: steering's fitting windows from the training items, at least E211's n_select 512
settings.rows_source: E224's: training fills from Pile train rows 0-32767, held-out fills from Pile val rows 64-8191 (rows 0-63 are the KL rows)
settings.seed_source: E220's training seeds; the item generators' seed as E224
settings.reader_settings_source: E211's filed reader settings and reproduce tolerances, read at run time from experiments/realistic_tasks/results/predictions_run2.json, as E222 and E224

thresholds.band_source: E215's filed rule.band (experiments/rl_67m/results/predictions.json thresholds.rule.band), inclusive at both ends; here on the exact expected reward rate (mean P(answer) at temperature 1), which E215's 8-sample rate estimates
thresholds.learn_min_se_source: E220's and E224's learned gate: RL seed 0's held-out rate at the stop minus at step 0 must exceed 2 x sqrt(se_0^2 + se_stop^2)

definitions.rate: mean over the 256 held-out items of P(the sampler draws the answer token at the cue), softmax over the tokenizer's ids at temperature 1; se = population sd over items / sqrt(256)
definitions.ctrl_rate: the same on each item's control prompt, for the same answer token: brackets, the answering opener swapped for another type (the answer is wrong there); sequence, the shown names shuffled; addition, the query's '+' made ','
definitions.readings (stage 2): E211's Reader.state on the CueRead rows (held-out prompts ending at the cue, unit lo = the answer's log-odds over the vocabulary, the answer riding as a last column neither the model nor Gamma reads): gain, prior, re-gating share, untrained SVD and rotated shares, neuron k64 and k-matched shares, pooled steering share with its random draws, k_half, effective rank, size. A ratio is read only at gain >= MIN_GAIN = 1

rules.smallest_gap_source: E222's filed rules (predictions_E222.json); E222's measured seed sd of the share, repeat RL 0.0555 (stage3/repeat_rl_s{0,1,2}.json), gives 2 se of an unpaired 3-vs-3 gap = 0.091, under 0.1
rules.drop at stage 0: a task whose W0 rate is outside the band is not trained or read (recorded in stage0.json .usable); no task inside stops the cell
rules.drop at stage 1: a task whose RL seed 0 does not reach the size target within max_steps, or whose rate does not rise by more than learn_min_se x se_diff, is dropped (train_<task>.json .stopped; its RL seed 0 state stays saved); se_diff 0 needs a strictly positive rise
rules.stop at stage 2: a Gaussian (random arm) state whose gain is at or over MIN_GAIN stops that task's read job (E222's do-nothing rule)
rules.RL vs SFT, per task, on the share (descr: E222's rule (experiments/rl_67m/score_stage3.py readable/alike/apart, smallest_gap 0.1, min_readable_seeds 2): 'not run' when the task was dropped; 'no call' when RL or SFT has fewer than 2 seeds with gain >= 1; 'rl above' when apart and every RL seed is above every SFT seed; 'sft above' likewise; 'alike' when alike; else 'neither'
rules.edge cases checked (score.py run1/run2 o: every task dropped: three 'not run'; one readable seed per arm: 'no call'; every RL share the string 'nan' (jsonable's nan): 'no call'; ranges apart by 0.3: 'rl above' and 'sft above' as built; ranges touching at 0.5 with gap 0.1 exactly not under 0.1: see 'alike' (gap 0.1 computed as 0.0999.. in floating point reads alike; a gap of exactly 0.1 is a tie the rule gives to alike); overlapping with gap 0.25: 'neither'; apart with gap 0.05: 'neither'. Run 2: Spearman None under 3 states with R_b or with a constant proxy. A share is nan, so not readable, when its gain is under MIN_GAIN = 1 (realistic_reads.ratio, gain >= 1 readable)

expected.stage 0 zero update: KL exactly 0.0; the same logits at every cue (torch.equal)
expected.stage 0 E211 ctl: every E53 re-read within E211's tolerances (as E222's ctl, stage3_ctl.json: lowercase share 0.7538 vs saved 0.7519, tol 0.01)
expected.stage 0 counts: 4096 training and 256 held-out items per task; template keys in both splits 0 for sequence (dry run: 726 train / 134 held keys) and brackets (552 / 120); addition shares its 55 facts by design (53 of 55 in the held-out 256)

W0 rate (benchmark).sequence: 0.15 to 0.35 (E224's W0 held-out top-1 0.272 on 1,024 items, stage2c_ctl.json; the mean probability sits under top-1 when the right name is often the argmax); usable, probability 0.85
W0 rate (benchmark).brackets: 0.10 to 0.40 (no prior reading: four closers, so 0.25 x P(a closer at all) ~0.15 with no skill, more with it); usable, probability 0.75
W0 rate (benchmark).addition: 0.08 to 0.30 with two worked sums (bare, E224's top-1 was 0.045 and contrast -2.62 against the other nine digits); usable, probability 0.6; the most likely task to be dropped, above the band with probability 0.1

expected.W0 ctrl_rate: sequence 0.01 to 0.06 (E224 ctrl top-1 0.021); brackets 0.05 to 0.20 (a wrong closer's share); addition 0.03 to 0.25 (the shots may still read ', ' as '+')
expected.stage 1 RL seed 0 (the learned gate): steps to the size target 20 to 35 (E224: 22-31); rate at the stop 0.4 to 0.8 (E224 top-1: sequence 0.26 -> 0.56-0.66, bare addition 0.045 -> 0.68); the gate passes on every usable task (probability 0.85 sequence, 0.75 brackets, 0.8 addition). KL from W0 at the stop 0.2 to 1.0 nats per token (E224 sequence 0.23-0.27, addition 0.34; plural 6-8 when it collapsed)
expected.stage 1 RL ctrl_rate at the stop: sequence up by under 0.05 (E224: 0.016 -> 0.035); brackets up by under 0.1 if RL learns which closer, more if it learns a closer prior; addition may rise a lot (E224 bare: 0.012 -> 0.69): a reading, no rule
expected.stage 1 SFT: steps 15 to 40 (E220's demo arms 23-25); rate at the stop 0.3 to 0.9 (the loss is on the one answer token, unlike E220's 16-token demonstrations); KL 0.05 to 0.5, under RL's (E220: 0.10-0.17 vs 2.9-3.9)
expected.stage 1 random: size equal to its RL seed's within 1e-4 relative; rate within 2 se of W0's; KL 0.01 to 0.1 (E215's random update of size 0.01 read above 0; E211's Gaussians)
expected.stage 2 zero update: every numerator and gain exactly 0.0, every ratio nan, k_half null (E211's zero record)
expected.stage 2 random (do-nothing): gain within +-0.05 of 0 (E211's nine Gaussians 0.002 to 0.02; E222's 0.002, 0.008, -0.009); every ratio nan; erank about 700 (E211's 700.17-700.24)
expected.stage 2 prior (W0, the same on every sta: sequence -2.5 to 0; brackets -3 to 0; addition -3 to -0.5 (log-odds of the answer)
expected.stage 2 gain: RL 1 to 4 (readable, probability 0.8 per task; E222 repeat RL 2.73-3.53); SFT 1 to 5 (readable, probability 0.7)
expected.stage 2 share on a readable state: 0.1 to 0.8 (E53's cipher 0.12 to lowercase 0.75; E222 repeat RL 0.68-0.79, anchor 0.53-0.56); no point value
expected.stage 2 baselines on a readable state: untrained SVD under the share, rotated 0.15 to 0.35 or negative (E222 repeat RL -0.06 to -0.32); neuron k64 and k-matched under 0.05; steering 0.2 to 1.1 with its random draws near 0; erank 500 to 650; k_half 5 to 1,024
expected.RL vs SFT (descriptive): no point prediction: rival a of the card (RL's share above SFT's by 0.1 or more) and rival b (within 0.1) are both open; 'no call' on a task with probability 0.3
expected.seconds: model load ~2 min (E218); ctl ~7 min (E211's ctl ~2.5 min, log commute-rl67m-s3-61974; items, zero and benchmark ~2 min); train per task ~6 min (RL ~13 s per seed, E224 stage2c; SFT at most ~40 s per seed, E220 demo; 9 saves and stop reads); read per task ~8 min (reader ~1 min, E211; ~23 s per state x 10 reads, E222's 18 s scaled to 256 rows)
